label: q input mid-sequence in sequences starting with t, after n/u/f
explanation: Very sparse conjunctive feature. It fires during the original phase when the input is q (85% of activation mass) at positions 4-7, and mostly in sequences whose first token is t (81% of mass). The strongest activations, e.g. t c p n u [q], also have n or u (sometimes f) shortly before the q. A small amount of mass falls on <DEL> or other tokens in t...n/u sequences. It never fires in the copy phase or at t<=2. q+first_tok t+position 4-7 has recall 0.54 and mass recall 0.66 but precision 0.16. Requiring an earlier n/u/f raises precision to 0.35 (F1 0.39, mass recall 0.58). So the feature reads a particular combination of history and the current q, and the exact combination is only partly captured. Lower-magnitude cases often lack n/u, or start with c or 3 instead of t.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=t (+5.44), prev_tok=u (+2.46), orig0=c (+2.20), orig1=t (+2.13), orig1=c (+2.07), phase=0 & in_tok=q (+1.97). Lower it: phase=2 (-2.49), prev3_tok=- (-2.32), orig1=h (-1.59), t=3 (-1.49).
